set.body:
Stage 4 of the post-closeout NumPy performance plan; this is a conditional decision gate, not implementation authorization.

Do not add a reassociating public reduction merely to improve a benchmark. Revisit sumFast or an explicit Associative policy only after the exact scalar work and targeted Vector spike are measured and a concrete consumer requests the speed/semantics tradeoff. Any proposal must specify NaN/signed-zero/overflow behavior, determinism and cross-platform boundaries, naming, migration/documentation, and benchmark benefit relative to the exact default.

If no credible user demand exists, close this bead as no-go and document the remaining reduction cost. The default fixed 128-value block-pairwise schedule must remain unchanged.
set.title: Gate any opt-in sumFast API on explicit user demand
